enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +15: Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Evocation Focus I: +1 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Kinetic Lore IV: Passive: Your Force, Physical and Untyped spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Impulse +66: Passive: +66 Equipment bonus to Force, Untyped, Slashing, Piercing, and Bludgeoning Spell Power.
Wizardry III: This item grants the wearer +75 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.
Flametouched Iron: Flametouched Iron grants +1 saves versus Evil Outsiders.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
